exposure: Rate of gestational weight gain (RGWG) in early pregnancy
Rate of gestational weight gain (RGWG) in mid pregnancy
Rate of gestational weight gain (RGWG) in late pregnancy
Pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) categories: Underweight, Normal, and Obese
Three groups based on pre-pregnancy BMI: Underweight, Normal, and Obese
finding: Early gestational weight gain was significantly associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, pregnancy-induced hypertension, large for gestational age infants, macrosomia, and primary cesarean section, particularly in women with normal or obese pre-pregnancy BMI.
mod_finding: Early RGWG was associated with a higher risk of primary cesarean section.
